patches_modified.name: Block background-return feed refresh
patches_modified.description: Keeps your place in your feed when you leave Threads and come back within ten minutes. Pulling down to refresh still loads new posts. Good if you hate losing the post you were reading. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Change version code
patches_modified.description: Raises the version number as high as Android allows, so Google Play won't offer Meta's updates over it. Going back to stock Threads means uninstalling, which deletes its data. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Stops Threads from sending most of its usage reports to Meta. A few may still get through. Good if you'd rather share less about how you use the app. On by default. Turn it off in HushThreads settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Disable screenshot detection
patches_modified.description: Threads isn't told when you take a screenshot. It stops watching your photos for new screenshots. Good if you want to screenshot without Threads noticing. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Disable swipe to Search
patches_modified.description: Stops a sideways swipe on your feed from sliding into Search. The Search button still opens Search. Threads only has the swipe on some accounts. Good if you keep landing in Search while you scroll. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Disable video autoplay
patches_modified.description: Videos in your feed wait for a tap instead of playing as you scroll. Good for a calmer feed and less data use. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Removes sponsored posts from your feed and from under the posts you open before Threads shows them, so they leave no gap. On by default. Turn it off in HushThreads settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide ghost post bubbles
patches_modified.description: Takes the ghost post bubbles off profile pictures, on profiles and in the row at the top of your feed. The pictures and the ghost posts themselves stay. Good for a calmer look. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Appearance.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested users
patches_modified.description: Removes the cards that suggest accounts to follow, in your feed and on profiles, and the Follow suggestions row in Search. Normal posts and reposts stay, and so does the rest of a profile or Search. Good if you only want posts in your feed. On by default. Its two switches are in HushThreads settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Instagram button
patches_modified.description: Takes the Instagram button off the top of profiles, yours and other people's. The other buttons stay. Good for a tidier profile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Appearance.

patches_modified.name: HushThreads settings
patches_modified.description: Adds a HushThreads page to Threads where you turn features on or off, pause HushThreads, back up your settings and read the licenses. Open it from Threads' own settings, or long-press the Threads logo at the top of your feed. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Max image quality
patches_modified.description: Loads photos at the largest size Threads has, instead of one picked for your screen. Photos look sharper but use more data. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Open links in browser
patches_modified.description: Opens links you tap in your regular browser instead of inside Threads, and skips Threads' link tracking. Threads, Instagram and other Meta pages still open in Threads. On by default. Turn it off in HushThreads settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Pure black dark mode
patches_modified.description: Makes Threads' dark mode truly black instead of dark gray behind your feed and posts. It looks deeper and can save battery on OLED screens. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Appearance.

patches_modified.name: Remove share targets
patches_modified.description: Takes Threads out of the share menu in other apps, so it isn't offered when you share a link, photo or video. Sharing from Threads still works. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Remove the advertising ID
patches_modified.description: Stops Threads from reading your phone's advertising ID. It gets a string of zeros instead. Good for making your phone harder to track across apps. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Restore screens on re-signed builds
patches_modified.description: Fixes Threads screens that fail on a patched app because they check who signed it. Also lets Threads share sign-in with an Instagram signed with this build's key, and makes the share sheet's tiles open patched Meta apps. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Hide blog notification reminders

patches_modified.name: Hide gift purchase popups

patches_modified.name: Hide hashtags

patches_modified.name: Remove Ads
patches_modified.description: Disables all ad serving in Hamro Patro by forcing the app's own ad policy gate to its "ads_disabled" verdict. Every banner, native, interstitial, app-open and rewarded request across the bundled MAX, AdMob, Pangle, ironSource, Facebook, Unity and Vungle stacks asks that gate first, so none is ever built. Works on its own, and combines cleanly with Nai64's universal No Ads patch.
patches_modified.previous_description: Disables all ad serving in Hamro Patro by no-oping the native ad-placement resolver (HamroAdsPlacements). Every banner, native, interstitial, fullscreen and roadblock placement funnels through these leaf builders, so returning an empty list means no ad request is ever built for the bundled MAX, Pangle, ironSource, Facebook Audience, Unity, Vungle and Google Ads SDKs, and no mediation cycle ever starts. Re-verified on v10.7.33. Works on its own, and combines cleanly with Nai64's universal No Ads patch if you have it enabled - the two act on different layers, so together they also cover the Google ads_mobile_sdk layer that no SDK-level patch reaches.

patches_added.name: Record calls
patches_added.description: Adds a Record button over Messenger during a call. The call goes into one sound file in Recordings/Messenger Calls on your phone (Music/Messenger Calls on Android 10 and 11). Messenger doesn't tell the other people, and recording laws differ from place to place, so get everyone's OK first. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Save button for voice messages
patches_added.description: Adds Save voice message to the menu you get by holding a voice message, for saving just that one. It goes in the same folder as Save voice messages you play, and that switch can stay off. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Search saved messages
patches_added.description: Adds a button to a chat's search results that searches the messages saved on this phone, for old chats Messenger's own search finds nothing in. It works in chats that aren't end-to-end encrypted, and it can only find what the phone has loaded. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Keep chat pop-ups
patches_added.description: Messenger can turn off message pop-ups for good when it expects a chat head to show. This stops that and brings them back on a phone where it already happened, unless you lowered them yourself in Android's settings or picked Chat heads under Allow chat bubbles.

patches_modified.name: Android Auto messages
patches_modified.description: Lets Android Auto read your Messenger messages out loud and send the replies you speak, through its own messaging screen. Android Auto only shows apps installed from the Play Store. Unknown sources in its developer settings opens that up on a desktop head unit, and a real car can still leave Messenger out. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

Android Auto only shows apps installed from the Play Store until you turn on Unknown sources in its developer settings. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Disable Analytics upload services
patches_added.description: Disables Google Analytics measurement upload services and its receiver.

patches_added.name: Disable Bluetooth access

patches_added.name: Disable Braze promotional push
patches_added.description: Disables Braze's push receiver. Talabat's separate Firebase order-messaging service is unchanged.

patches_added.name: Disable Firebase session reporting
patches_added.description: Disables Firebase's session lifecycle reporting service. Crash and analytics controls remain separate.

patches_added.name: Disable Google Tag Manager
patches_added.description: Disables the Tag Manager background service used for marketing measurement.

patches_added.name: Disable Google telemetry transport
patches_added.description: Disables Google's background telemetry upload scheduler and alarm receivers.

patches_added.name: Disable Huawei ads identifier
patches_added.description: Removes Huawei's advertising-identifier service declaration while leaving Huawei login and maps intact.

patches_added.name: Disable NFC access
patches_added.description: Removes NFC access from Talabat.

patches_added.name: Disable Sentry ANR profiling
patches_added.description: Sets Sentry's ANR profiling sample rate to zero.

patches_added.name: Disable Sentry ANR reports
patches_added.description: Disables Sentry application-not-responding reports.

patches_added.name: Disable Sentry ANR thread dumps
patches_added.description: Prevents Sentry from attaching thread dumps to ANR reports.

patches_added.name: Disable Sentry SurfaceView replay
patches_added.description: Prevents Sentry replay from capturing SurfaceView content.

patches_added.name: Disable Sentry app-start tracing
patches_added.description: Disables automatic startup and activity lifecycle performance traces.

patches_added.name: Disable Sentry breadcrumbs
patches_added.description: Prevents application-supplied breadcrumbs from being recorded by Sentry.

patches_added.name: Disable Sentry cache tracing
patches_added.description: Disables Sentry performance traces for cache operations.

patches_added.name: Disable Sentry crash reports
patches_added.description: Suppresses Sentry events, exceptions, messages, and user-feedback reports while returning an empty event ID.

patches_added.name: Disable Sentry crash screenshots
patches_added.description: Prevents Sentry from attaching screenshots to crash events.

patches_added.name: Disable Sentry database tracing
patches_added.description: Disables Sentry performance traces for database transactions.

patches_added.name: Disable Sentry device context
patches_added.description: Prevents Sentry from collecting additional device context.

patches_added.name: Disable Sentry error replay
patches_added.description: Disables Sentry replay capture associated with errors.

patches_added.name: Disable Sentry frame tracking
patches_added.description: Disables Sentry frame-rate and rendering performance collection.

patches_added.name: Disable Sentry full-display tracing
patches_added.description: Disables Sentry's time-to-full-display performance traces.

patches_added.name: Disable Sentry historical ANRs
patches_added.description: Disables Sentry reports for historical application-not-responding events.

patches_added.name: Disable Sentry interaction breadcrumbs
patches_added.description: Prevents taps and other user interactions from becoming Sentry breadcrumbs.

patches_added.name: Disable Sentry interaction tracing
patches_added.description: Disables Sentry performance traces built from user interactions.

patches_added.name: Disable Sentry lifecycle breadcrumbs
patches_added.description: Disables activity, application, and component lifecycle breadcrumbs.

patches_added.name: Disable Sentry logcat collection
patches_added.description: Prevents Sentry from turning logcat messages into breadcrumbs or Sentry logs. Logcat output itself is unchanged.

patches_added.name: Disable Sentry native crash preload
patches_added.description: Disables Sentry's native crash-handler preload provider.

patches_added.name: Disable Sentry native reporting
patches_added.description: Disables Sentry's native NDK integration.

patches_added.name: Disable Sentry network breadcrumbs
patches_added.description: Prevents network changes from becoming Sentry breadcrumbs.

patches_added.name: Disable Sentry performance V2
patches_added.description: Disables Sentry's second-generation automatic performance collection.

patches_added.name: Disable Sentry performance traces
patches_added.description: Sets Sentry's performance trace sample rate to zero.

patches_added.name: Disable Sentry profiling
patches_added.description: Sets Sentry's profiling sample rate to zero.

patches_added.name: Disable Sentry queue tracing
patches_added.description: Disables Sentry performance traces for queue operations.

patches_added.name: Disable Sentry raw tombstones
patches_added.description: Prevents Sentry from attaching raw native tombstone data.

patches_added.name: Disable Sentry replay network bodies
patches_added.description: Prevents Sentry replay from capturing network request and response bodies.

patches_added.name: Disable Sentry root reporting
patches_added.description: Disables Sentry's root-status checks and reporting.

patches_added.name: Disable Sentry session replay
patches_added.description: Displays no Sentry session-replay capture. This is separate from crash screenshots.

patches_added.name: Disable Sentry startup performance
patches_added.description: Disables Sentry's automatic startup performance provider.

patches_added.name: Disable Sentry storage context
patches_added.description: Prevents Sentry from collecting external-storage context.

patches_added.name: Disable Sentry system breadcrumbs
patches_added.description: Disables system-event breadcrumbs and their extra device details.

patches_added.name: Disable Sentry tombstone reports
patches_added.description: Disables Sentry tombstone collection and historical tombstone reporting.

patches_added.name: Disable Sentry view hierarchy capture
patches_added.description: Prevents Sentry from attaching the app's view hierarchy to events.

patches_added.name: Disable Shake Bugs activity history
patches_added.description: Prevents Shake Bugs from recording lifecycle and touch activity.

patches_added.name: Disable Shake Bugs console logs
patches_added.description: Prevents application log messages from being added to Shake Bugs reports.

patches_added.name: Disable Shake Bugs crash reports
patches_added.description: Suppresses Shake Bugs error handling, silent reports, and crash-report enablement.

patches_added.name: Disable Shake Bugs identity tracking
patches_added.description: Prevents Shake Bugs from receiving user IDs, metadata, and push tokens.

patches_added.name: Disable Shake Bugs initialization
patches_added.description: Prevents Shake Bugs from starting. Other Shake Bugs switches are unnecessary when this is selected.

patches_added.name: Disable Shake Bugs network inspection
patches_added.description: Prevents Shake Bugs from recording network requests and responses.

patches_added.name: Disable Shake Bugs notification history
patches_added.description: Prevents Shake Bugs from recording notification events.

patches_added.name: Disable Shake Bugs screen recording
patches_added.description: Disables Shake Bugs' foreground screen-recording service.

patches_added.name: Disable Shake Bugs user feedback
patches_added.description: Disables Shake Bugs' user-feedback collection.

patches_added.name: Disable WebView DOM storage
patches_added.description: Disables WebView DOM storage. Some signed-in WebView pages may lose local state.

patches_added.name: Disable WebView background audio
patches_added.description: Prevents in-app WebView pages from continuing audio in the background.

patches_added.name: Disable WebView cache
patches_added.description: Disables WebView caching to reduce retained browsing data. Network usage may increase.

patches_added.name: Disable WebView database storage
patches_added.description: Disables the legacy WebView database API and its stored data.

patches_added.name: Disable WebView form saving
patches_added.description: Prevents in-app WebView pages from saving form data.

patches_added.name: Disable WebView geolocation
patches_added.description: Prevents in-app WebView pages from requesting device location through the browser API.

patches_added.name: Disable background location
patches_added.description: Removes background-location access. Foreground delivery addresses and order tracking can still work.

patches_added.name: Disable camera access

patches_added.name: Disable country geofence notifications

patches_added.name: Disable high-rate sensors
patches_added.description: Removes access to high-sampling-rate motion sensors used by diagnostics and gesture detection.

patches_added.name: Disable legacy external storage

patches_added.name: Disable microphone access

patches_added.name: Disable screenshot detection

patches_added.name: Disable system overlays

patches_added.name: Hide Braze content cards

patches_added.name: Hide Shake Bugs chat notifications

patches_added.name: Hide Shake Bugs introduction

patches_added.name: Hide Shake Bugs report UI

patches_added.description: Removes access to Android Privacy Sandbox advertising identifiers.

patches_added.name: Review content filter

patches_added.name: Settings backup and restore

patches_added.name: Share links

patches_added.name: Text size
